descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Asociat
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
Who We Are
 We operate beyond organizational silos, combining deep expertise in data engineering and AI-driven solutions to design and deliver scalable, user-centric applications and modern data architectures. We support a wide range of industries, including Automotive, Banking, Insurance, Telecommunications, E-commerce, and Public Services.
We are looking for a hands-on Senior AI Engineer to design, build, and operate secure, production-grade AI solutions within an AWS-centered environment. The role combines software engineering, Generative AI, agentic workflows, RAG, cloud integration, evaluation, and LLMOps, with responsibility for moving solutions from initial use-case definition through deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
 What You'll Be Doing
Design and implement Generative AI and AI-agent solutions using Amazon Bedrock and appropriate foundation models.
Build agent workflows covering planning, tool use, structured outputs, state, memory, routing, retries, failure recovery, and human approval.
Develop enterprise RAG solutions using Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases, Amazon OpenSearch Service, PostgreSQL with pgvector, embeddings, hybrid retrieval, reranking, grounding, and citations.
Integrate AI applications and agents with REST APIs, databases, enterprise platforms, knowledge repositories, and event-driven services.
Build scalable serverless or containerized components using AWS Lambda, API Gateway, Amazon S3, ECS or EKS, and related AWS services.
Implement identity, secrets, encryption, private connectivity, audit logging, least-privilege access, and AI-specific safety controls.
Define automated and human evaluation approaches covering retrieval quality, groundedness, hallucination, task success, tool correctness, safety, latency, and cost.
Establish CI/CD, infrastructure as code, testing, observability, monitoring, incident response, and rollback practices for AI applications.
Optimize model selection, prompts, retrieval strategies, token consumption, inference performance, reliability, and operational cost.
Collaborate with architects, domain experts, platform teams, and business stakeholders while producing reusable code, technical documentation, and production handover materials. 
 What you'll bring along 
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field.
5+ years of professional software, cloud, data, or AI engineering experience, including hands-on delivery of production AI or machine-learning solutions.
Strong Python development skills; experience with TypeScript or another enterprise programming language is considered a plus.
Hands-on experience with Amazon Bedrock, foundation-model integration, Bedrock Knowledge Bases, agents, guardrails, and model-evaluation approaches.
Experience with AWS Lambda, API Gateway, Amazon S3, IAM, CloudWatch, and scalable serverless or container-based application patterns.
Production experience with LLM applications, RAG, embeddings, vector and semantic search, prompt and context engineering, tool calling, and multi-step agentic workflows.
Experience integrating AI solutions with REST APIs, databases, enterprise applications, event-driven services, and structured and unstructured data sources.
Experience with Git, CI/CD, automated testing, Docker, infrastructure as code, observability, secure cloud architecture, and production support.
Strong understanding of grounding, hallucination mitigation, prompt-injection and jailbreak prevention, PII protection, content controls, auditability, human oversight, and Responsible AI.
Experience with Amazon SageMaker, OpenSearch, PostgreSQL/pgvector, LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, MCP, or comparable frameworks is considered a plus.
Relevant AWS AI, machine-learning, developer, or architecture certifications and experience in regulated enterprise environments are considered a plus.
Excellent command of both spoken and written English.
